## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.

import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
      if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })
        res.write(': connected\n\n')
        clients.add(res)
        req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
        return
      }
      const path = resolve(root, '.' + decodeURIComponent(url.pathname))
      if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }
      const file = statSync(path).isDirectory() ? join(path, 'index.html') : path
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime[extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream')
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', url.searchParams.has('omgithub_live') ? 'no-store' : 'no-cache')
      const content = readFileSync(file)
      if (extname(file) === '.html' && url.searchParams.get('omgithub_live') === '1') {
        const html = content.toString()
        res.end(/<\/body\s*>/i.test(html) ? html.replace(/<\/body\s*>/i, `${livePreviewScript}</body>`) : html + livePreviewScript)
      } else res.end(content)
    } catch { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found') }
  })
  server.on('close', () => { stopWatching(); clearInterval(keepAlive); buildWatcher?.kill(); for (const client of clients) client.end() })
  server.listen(Number(process.env.PORT || 3000), '0.0.0.0')
  return server
}
if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) await start()

Network works. We'll use Vite 7 or 8? Node 24 supports Vite 8. Use latest. Three 0.187.

Let's think architecture carefully to deliver quality.

Files:
- package.json
- index.html
- src/main.js
- src/styles.css
- src/game/... maybe modular:
  - src/game/data.js (classes, maps, items, enemies)
  - src/game/world.js (build scenes, environment)
  - src/game/entities.js (player/enemy models)
  - src/game/audio.js (WebAudio synth)
  - src/game/input.js (touch joystick + buttons)
  - src/game/combat.js maybe integrated
  - src/ui.js (DOM screens, HUD, shop)
  - src/main.js (orchestrator)
Could do fewer files but well-structured.

Visual quality: Use Three.js low-poly procedural models. We can build characters from primitives with stylized colors. Use capsule/cylinder/sphere; add animation via group transforms. Shadows, lights, fog, post-processing? Avoid heavy postprocessing. Use ACES tone mapping, shadow maps, sky gradients via shader/background, particles.

Camera: Isometric-ish third person follow at offset (0, 9, 11), look at player, smoothed. Arena-style maps with obstacles. Movement 8-direction relative to camera. Attack auto-target nearest enemy in range/front. Aim direction based on movement/facing.

Gameplay loop:
- Start menu (title, "Jogar", class select).
- Character select screen with 5 cards and 3D preview? Could use same Three canvas with character lineup in background. Simpler: character select overlay with animated CSS art/portraits maybe use canvas-generated? We can render 3D character lineup behind UI. That's fancy. Could create a "showcase" scene with rotating characters. But implementation time. We can do class select as DOM cards with emoji/gradient, plus 3D scene behind showing the selected character rotating on a pedestal. That would look good.

States:
- boot/title: 3D scene "title" with hero silhouette? Maybe just title screen with CSS gradient and 3D animated environment behind. We can have a persistent renderer and scene manager.
- select: 3D character on pedestal; click cards.
- lobby: 3D scene with vendor + dog, player can walk. HUD with "Ir para a Lobby" button? Lobby itself; maps accessible through portals or map board. Requirement specifically "Botão de ir para a Lobby" likely during gameplay. We'll have top-right lobby button in adventure. Also in lobby, map select board.
- adventure: combat in map, waves and objective, boss, portal back? Lobby button.

Lobby shop:
- Vendor "Maelis, a Mercadora" with dog "Brasa" (guide dog). Need visible 3D. Shop UI opened when near/interact or click. List of weapons/armor/consumables, prices, buy/equip. Inventory/equipment system affects stats. Need classes have weapon restrictions? Simpler each class starts with their weapon and can buy upgrades universal tiers, plus class-specific weapons. One whip class: "Seraphine" with whip. Shop sells whips too.
- Equipment slots: arma, armadura, amuleto. Stats attack, defense, maxHP, maxMana, speed, crit.
- Gold earned from kills; persists via localStorage; purchases persist.
- Potion purchase and inventory (heal).

Map select: 4 cards with recommended level, enemy types, theme, boss. Unlock progressively? Requirement 4 maps; maybe all available. Add difficulty scaling. Complete map unlocks next? Could gate but for demo maybe all open to show content. But progression satisfying: map 1 open, maps unlock as you clear. Yet user wants 4 maps; testers may not want grind. We can make all available but recommended levels. Or unlock after each; provide "all unlocked" maybe no. I think show all four but have difficulty labels and bosses. Lobby portal stones arranged in 3D with labels? Could have DOM map select modal with 4 cards.

Combat:
- Enemies spawn in waves; defeat 3 waves then boss; portal/exit opens. Map 1 maybe 2 waves. Each map has 3 waves + boss.
- Health bars floating above enemies; player HUD health/mana/XP/gold.
- Basic attack: melee arc hit / ranged projectile depending class. Whip attack: long arc. Mage ranged fireball projectile. Ranger arrow. Rogue quick slashes.
- Abilities (3 per class) with cooldowns and mana. Buttons with icons/cooldown overlay.
- Dodge button with stamina? Maybe simple dash cooldown.
- Potion button.
- Enemy AI: move toward player, attack with windup, telegraphs; ranged casters; boss special attacks (ground slam AoE).
- Damage numbers, hit flashes, screen shake, particles.
- Loot drops (gold orbs, health/mana orbs, gear maybe).
- Victory screen with rewards and return to lobby. Defeat screen with retry/lobby.
- Level/XP maybe simple: gain XP, level up stats.

Map environments:
1. "Cripta de Brasa" (volcanic crypt) — dark stone, lava pools, orange lighting, fire enemies.
2. "Ruínas de Verdan" (overgrown ruins) — green, pillars, fireflies, vine enemies.
3. "Vale Glacial" (frozen) — blue/white, ice crystals, snow particles, ice enemies.
4. "Cidadela do Eclipse" (shadow citadel) — purple, floating rocks, void, boss.
Each with distinct sky/fog/ground color, props (pillars, crystals, trees, lava rocks), particles. Arena enclosed with decorative boundary. Use procedural geometry.

Character designs:
- Kaelen (Guardião) — sword & shield, steel/blue, tanky.
- Lyra (Feiticeira) — staff, purple/orange, mage.
- Vex (Lâmina Sombria) — dual daggers, black/teal, rogue.
- Sylva (Domadora) — bow + spirit wolf? Maybe hunter with bow, green; ability summons spirit wolf that attacks.
- Seraphine (Dançarina do Açoite) — whip, crimson/gold, long-range melee.
Need distinctive silhouettes and weapons. Build 3D humanoid with body parts: legs, torso, head, arms; weapon groups. Use primitives: CapsuleGeometry, Sphere, Cylinder, Cone, Box. Add capes/hair. Whip: line of segments? Build as curved tube? Use CatmullRomCurve3 + TubeGeometry with glow material, animate slight wave. Or chain of small spheres/segments. We can build whip as a set of 12 small glowing spheres along a curve trailing from hand, animate. Attack animation swings.

Weapon equips change visual color/glow maybe not geometry; we can tint blade and scale. Shop weapon per class with names.

UI style: dark fantasy, gold accents, serif headings (Cinzel via Google Fonts? network may be blocked at runtime for fonts; better use local system serif or embed? Use CSS font-family Georgia/'Times New Roman' + maybe @import from Google Fonts but fallback fine. Avoid external network). Use UI with ornate borders, gradients. Portrait cards with custom CSS silhouettes? Better render 3D character preview on cards via canvas? Could use one offscreen renderer generating portraits at boot. That's doable: create scene per class, render 256x256, toDataURL, use as card background. That gives cohesive look. We'll do portrait generation maybe after assets ready, with separate WebGLRenderer? Could reuse main renderer to render to a canvas then dataURL. Simpler: each card includes a live mini-canvas? Too heavy. Generate portraits with a temporary renderer and dispose. Or use the main renderer render each character scene to a render target and extract image via canvas. Could just render to offscreen renderer 300x300 per class once. 5 WebGL contexts may hit limits if not disposed. Use one renderer created, render each, toDataURL, dispose renderer. Works.

Title screen: CSS overlay with game title, tagline, "Entrar na Lenda" button, and 3D background of lobby? Maybe main scene shows a cinematic camera over a map. To reduce complexity, render a title scene with 5 heroes standing on a cliff platform with torches, slow camera orbit. This is impressive. Then clicking play goes to character select (same 3D lineup) with cards overlay.

Character select: background 3D scene with selected hero centered on pedestal, others in shadows? Could render selected hero rotating, plus title. Cards at bottom. We'll manage scenes per state.

Lobby: create environment: cobblestone plaza, market stalls, fountain, warm lighting, vendor behind counter with dog beside. Player character controllable. A glowing portal/board with 4 map stones. Shop open when pressing "Falar com Maelis" button or clicking vendor marker. To keep mobile-friendly, show a prominent "Mercado" button and "Mapas" button plus movement. Requirement lobby vendor; UI can show vendor and dog. When player approaches vendor, interact prompt appears. But testers need easy access. We'll have buttons in lobby: "Loja da Maelis" and "Mapa do Mundo" and "Ir para Aventura" maybe. Also direct clicking on vendor via raycast. Keep movement enabled in lobby with joystick for immersion, NPCs idle animate. 3D vendor + dog clearly visible, with nameplates floating.

Map selection: modal overlay with 4 beautiful cards (rendered thumbnails via offscreen render of map scene? Could use CSS gradient + icon). Better generate map thumbnails using 3D scenes at boot? More work; CSS atmospheric gradients and custom SVG icons might be fine. But quality demands. Could make 4 cards with generated 3D thumbnails from environment scenes. Maybe use simple CSS with background gradients and emoji icons; less impressive. We can generate using renderer + simplified map scene. Hmm.

Given time, we can create portrait cards with generated 3D. For maps, create cards with CSS gradient and large rune icon (SVG) and colors. Good.

Audio: WebAudio procedural ambient/music and SFX. Music: simple looping arpeggio synth for lobby and battle. Adds quality. Mute toggle. Need user gesture to start. We'll implement small AudioEngine with oscillators, no assets. Attack/hit/pickup sounds. Maybe subtle.

Performance on mobile: limit pixel ratio 2, shadows 1024, low-poly, particle cap. Use instanced? Fine.

Need ensure touch controls: virtual joystick bottom-left, attack big button bottom-right, ability buttons around, potion, dodge. Top bar with HP/mana, gold, level. Lobby button top right. Use pointer events, touch-action none, prevent context menu. Safe-area padding. Landscape orientation recommended; handle portrait with rotate overlay? Android phones; game better landscape. Could support both but show "Gire o dispositivo" overlay in portrait? Requirements mobile usable. Many games force landscape. Could add a rotate hint but not block. Better design responsive: in portrait, controls still work with camera adjusted. However screen is tight. We can implement an orientation overlay "Melhor em paisagem" with continue? Hmm. For quality, force landscape by CSS rotate? No. Add full-screen prompt in portrait with "Girar dispositivo" and option "Jogar assim" maybe. Simpler: game works in both; layout adjusts, camera FOV. Playwright screenshots at 1280x720 or mobile 844x390.

Testing: use playwright-cli to open and screenshot. Need figure out how to interact. Could also use node playwright library? playwright-cli exists. Check help. We can use browser via playwright-cli commands: open, click, screenshot, eval? Let's inspect.

content.text:
playwright-cli - run playwright mcp commands from terminal

Usage: playwright-cli <command> [args] [options]
Usage: playwright-cli -s=<session> <command> [args] [options]

Core:
  open [url]                  open the browser
  attach [name]               attach to a running playwright browser
  close                       close the browser
  detach                      detach from an attached browser
  goto <url>                  navigate to a url
  type <text>                 type text into editable element
  click <target> [button]     perform click on a web page
  dblclick <target> [button]  perform double click on a web page
  fill <target> <text>        fill text into editable element
  drag <startTarget> <endTarget> perform drag and drop between two elements
  drop <target>               drop files or data onto an element
  hover <target>              hover over element on page
  select <target> <val>       select an option in a dropdown
  upload <files...>           upload one or multiple files
  check <target>              check a checkbox or radio button
  uncheck <target>            uncheck a checkbox or radio button
  snapshot [target]           capture page snapshot to obtain element ref
  find [text]                 search the page snapshot for text or a regexp, returning matching nodes with surrounding context (like search snippets)
  eval <func> [target]        evaluate javascript expression on page or element
  dialog-accept [prompt]      accept a dialog
  dialog-dismiss              dismiss a dialog
  resize <w> <h>              resize the browser window
  delete-data                 delete session data

Navigation:
  go-back                     go back to the previous page
  go-forward                  go forward to the next page
  reload                      reload the current page

Keyboard:
  press <key>                 press a key on the keyboard, `a`, `arrowleft`
  keydown <key>               press a key down on the keyboard
  keyup <key>                 press a key up on the keyboard

Mouse:
  mousemove <x> <y>           move mouse to a given position
  mousedown [button]          press mouse down
  mouseup [button]            press mouse up
  mousewheel <dx> <dy>        scroll mouse wheel

Save as:
  screenshot [target]         screenshot of the current page or element
  pdf                         save page as pdf

Tabs:
  tab-list                    list all tabs
  tab-new [url]               create a new tab
  tab-close [index]           close a browser tab
  tab-select <index>          select a browser tab

Storage:
  state-load <filename>       loads browser storage (authentication) state from a file
  state-save [filename]       saves the current storage (authentication) state to a file
  cookie-list                 list all cookies (optionally filtered by domain/path)
  cookie-get <name>           get a specific cookie by name
  cookie-set <name> <value>   set a cookie with optional flags
  cookie-delete <name>        delete a specific cookie
  cookie-clear                clear all cookies
  localstorage-list           list all localstorage key-value pairs
  localstorage-get <key>      get a localstorage item by key
  localstorage-set <key> <value> set a localstorage item
  localstorage-delete <key>   delete a localstorage item
  localstorage-clear          clear all localstorage
  sessionstorage-list         list all sessionstorage key-value pairs
  sessionstorage-get <key>    get a sessionstorage item by key
  sessionstorage-set <key> <value> set a sessionstorage item
  sessionstorage-delete <key> delete a sessionstorage item
  sessionstorage-clear        clear all sessionstorage

Network:
  requests                    list all network requests since loading the page. each request is numbered for use with the `request` command.
  request <index>             show full details (headers, body, response) of a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  request-headers <index>     print only the request headers for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.
  request-body <index>        print only the request body for a single network request by its number from the `requests` command.

content.text:
playwright-cli open [url]

Open the browser

Arguments:
  [url]                       the url to navigate to
Options:
  --browser                   browser or chrome channel to use, possible values: chrome, firefox, webkit, msedge.
  --config                    path to the configuration file, defaults to .playwright/cli.config.json
  --device                    emulate a specific device, for example "iphone 15".
  --headed                    run browser in headed mode
  --mobile                    emulate a generic mobile device (pixel 10 for chromium, iphone 17 for webkit). mobile pages are usually lighter, which saves tokens.
  --persistent                use persistent browser profile
  --profile                   path to a persistent user data directory.
playwright-cli screenshot [target]

screenshot of the current page or element

Arguments:
  [target]                    exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector
Options:
  --filename                  file name to save the screenshot to. defaults to `page-{timestamp}.{png|jpeg|webp}` if not specified.
  --type                      image format. if unset, inferred from the filename extension, otherwise png. (one of: png, jpeg, webp)
  --full-page                 when true, takes a screenshot of the full scrollable page, instead of the currently visible viewport.
  --hires                     when true, captures a high-resolution screenshot using device pixels (accounts for the device pixel ratio), instead of css pixels.

Let's plan code in detail.

Main architecture:

`src/data.js`:
- CLASSES array with id, name, title, role, color, accent, description, stats base {hp, mana, power, defense, speed}, weapon {name, type, damage, range, arc, attackRate, projectile?}, abilities [3] {id,name,desc,icon,cooldown,mana,type}, model config.

`src/models.js`:
- `createHero(classId, {portrait=false})` returns THREE.Group with parts and animation refs. Use helper add primitives with MeshStandardMaterial flatShading.

`src/world.js`:

export function xpForLevel(level) {
  return XP_THRESHOLDS[Math.min(level - 1, XP_THRESHOLDS.length - 1)] || 0;
}

export function nextLevelXp(level) {
  return XP_THRESHOLDS[Math.min(level, XP_THRESHOLDS.length - 1)] || XP_THRESHOLDS[XP_THRESHOLDS.length - 1];
}

export function levelFromXp(totalXp) {
  let level = 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < XP_THRESHOLDS.length; i++) {
    if (totalXp >= XP_THRESHOLDS[i]) level = i + 1;
  }
  return Math.min(level, XP_THRESHOLDS.length);
}

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a 3D Android-friendly browser action RPG inspired by *Champions of Norrath*, with 5 playable classes, 4 maps, real-time combat, a lobby with a vendor and guide dog, a shop, and a lobby-return button.
- The user request is in Portuguese and includes: "Crie um jogo, como Champions of Norrath de ps2 em 3d, para Android, Com 5 personagens diferentes jogáveis, rpg. Diferentes classes, e poderes, habilidades diferentes, e 4 mapas diferentes, crie também um Botão de ir para a lobby, a lobby terá Uma vendedora com um cachorro guia, ela vende Equipamentos e Armas, sistema de combate. Faça um dos 5 personagens ter um chicote como equipamento."

## Requirements
- 3D action RPG playable on Android mobile browsers.
- 5 distinct playable characters/classes with different powers and abilities.
- 4 different maps.
- A visible "go to lobby" button.
- Lobby containing a female vendor with a guide dog; she sells equipment and weapons.
- Full combat system.
- One of the five characters must use a whip as their weapon.
- Portuguese UI/text expected.

## Decisions
- Use Vite + Three.js with procedural low-poly 3D assets (no external model downloads) for reliable build and Android performance.
- Single-page state flow: title → character select → lobby → map select → adventure → victory/defeat → lobby.
- Game title: **Lendas de Aethermoor**.
- Five classes:
  - Kaelen, O Guardião (tank/sword & shield)
  - Lyra, A Feiticeira (mage/staff)
  - Vex, A Lâmina Sombria (assassin/dual daggers)
  - Sylva, A Domadora (ranger/bow)
  - Seraphine, A Dançarina do Açoite (whip user)
- Four maps: Cripta de Brasa, Ruínas de Verdan, Vale Glacial, Cidadela do Eclipse.
- Lobby vendor named Maelis, guide dog named Brasa.
- Procedurally generate hero portraits, vendor portrait, and map thumbnails using an offscreen WebGL renderer at boot.
- Save profile/gold/equipment/completed maps to `localStorage`.
- Include WebAudio procedural music/SFX, touch joystick, combat buttons, keyboard support, minimap, floating damage numbers, enemy health bars, boss bar, buffs, potions, and shop.
- Current implementation is uncommitted.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created project scaffolding and full UI structure.
- `package.json`, `index.html`, `src/styles.css` completed.
- `src/data.js` completed with classes, abilities, enemies, bosses, maps, shop items, XP thresholds.
- `src/icons.js` completed with inline SVG icon set.
- `src/models.js` completed with procedural hero/enemy/boss/vendor/dog models, weapons (including whip), animations, loot orbs, spirit wolf.
- `src/worlds.js` completed with title scene, showcase/select scene, lobby, 4 adventure maps, map dioramas.
- `src/audio.js` completed with procedural music and SFX.
- `src/input.js` completed with joystick, keyboard, touch buttons.
- `src/profile.js` completed with save/load, stats, XP, shop purchase/equip helpers.
- `src/ui.js` completed with screens, class cards, shop/maps modals, HUD, damage numbers, enemy bars, minimap, result/pause/help UI.
- All JS files pass `node --check`.
- Added mana potion button to HUD and input binding.
- Fixed wraith floating baseY bug.
- Added CSS for mana potion and `#hit-flash`.

### Active
- `src/main.js` was being written but the write call failed because the payload exceeded the output token limit. **`src/main.js` does not currently exist or is incomplete.**
- Main game orchestration remains to be implemented.

### Blocked
- `src/main.js` missing, so the game cannot run yet.
- Need to install dependencies (`npm install`) and test with Vite/Playwright after main.js is added.

## Next Move
1. Create `src/main.js` in smaller chunks if needed, importing existing modules and implementing:
   - boot/art generation, renderer setup, resize handling;
   - title/select/lobby/adventure state transitions;
   - lobby movement, vendor/dog/map-board raycast interactions;
   - combat loop, player attacks, all 5 classes' 3 abilities, enemies/boss AI, projectiles, effects, pickups, spirit wolf;
   - wave spawning, victory/defeat, rewards, XP/level-up, save;
   - shop buy/equip callbacks, sound toggle, pause/help/result handling;
   - floating damage numbers, enemy bars, minimap, camera follow, screen shake.
2. Run `npm install`, then `npm run dev -- --port 3002` or `./start.sh`.
3. Use Playwright CLI to open `http://localhost:3002`, screenshot title/select/lobby/shop/map/combat, inspect for blank canvas/runtime errors.
4. Fix visual/functional issues, then run `npm run build` and final smoke test.
5. Update README with game instructions/controls if time permits.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: missing core game loop/orchestration; highest priority.
- `src/data.js`: classes, abilities, enemies, maps, shop items, XP thresholds.
- `src/models.js`: all procedural 3D characters/enemies/vendor/dog/whip; exposes `createHero`, `animateHero`, `createEnemy`, `animateEnemy`, `createVendor`, `createDog`, `animateVendor`, `animateDog`, `createSpiritWolf`, `createHealthOrb`, `createManaOrb`, `createGoldOrb`, `createGroundRing`, `glowMat`.
- `src/worlds.js`: `buildTitleWorld`, `buildShowcaseWorld`, `buildLobbyWorld`, `buildAdventureWorld`, `buildMapDiorama`.
- `src/ui.js`: `GameUI` class; UI handlers expected via `ui.handlers` keys: `onStart`, `onBackTitle`, `onSelectClass`, `onConfirmClass`, `onOpenShop`, `onOpenMaps`, `onCloseModal`, `onEnterMap`, `onLobby`, `onPause`, `onResume`, `onPauseLobby`, `onRetry`, `onResultLobby`, `onOpenHelp`, `onCloseHelp`, `onBuy`, `onEquip`, `onSound`.
- `src/profile.js`: `loadProfile`, `saveProfile`, `computeStats`, `grantXp`, `buyItem`, `equipItem`, `xpProgress`, `getEquipped`, `itemStatsText`, `shopItemsFor`.
- `src/input.js`: `Input` class; emits `attack`, `ability`, `dodge`, `potion` with `'health'|'mana'`, `pause`, `lobby`, `uiClick`; exposes `attackHeld`, `consumeAttack()`, `getMove()`.
- `src/audio.js`: `AudioEngine` with `init`, `setMood`, `play`, `toggleMute`, `setMuted`.
- `src/styles.css`: all screen/HUD/modal styling and responsive mobile layout.
- `index.html`: full DOM structure and element IDs.
- `package.json`: Vite/Three setup, scripts `dev`, `build`, `preview`.
- `start.sh` / `capture.sh`: runtime wrappers expecting Vite project and port 3002.

## Important Context
- Current working directory: `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround`.
- Repo was essentially empty; only runtime scaffolding and skills existed.
- `package.json` dependencies: `three ^0.187.0`; devDependency `vite ^7.1.0`.
- Runtime `default-start.mjs` supports Vite projects and builds to `dist`; deployment output must contain `index.html`.
- `node --check` passed for all existing `src/*.js` before main.js creation.
- `src/ui.js` references `this.profile`, `this.currentClass`, and `ui.handlers`; main must set these.
- `src/worlds.js` uses `createTextSprite` with canvas text; requires browser DOM.
- `src/models.js` uses shared global geometries; avoid disposing them when switching scenes.
- `src/data.js` has `CLASS_BY_ID`, `MAP_BY_ID`, `ENEMIES`, `ITEM_BY_ID`, `RARITY_COLORS`, `XP_THRESHOLDS`.
- Whip class is `whipdancer` / Seraphine; starting weapon `w_whipdancer_0` named **Açoite de Sangue**; upgrades include **Chicote do Sol** and **Cauda do Dragão**.
- Lobby has `interactables`:
  - shop at approx `(-5.6, -4.2)` range 3.1
  - maps at `(6.4, -2.0)` range 2.9
- `buildLobbyWorld()` returns `playerStart` `(0,0,7.4)`, `bounds:19`, `obstacles`, `vendor`, `dog`, `mapBoard`, `update`.
- `buildAdventureWorld(mapId)` returns `playerStart (0,0,9)`, `bounds:21`, `bossSpawn (0,0,-11)`, `spawnPoints`, `obstacles`, `update`, `map`.
- Map wave structure: each `map.waves` entry has `label`, `enemies: [[type,count],...]`, optional `boss:true`.
- Boss IDs: `boneTyrant`, `thornColossus`, `frostSentinel`, `eclipseLord`.
- Map rewards: crypt 130 gold/140 XP; ruins 220/260; ice 340/420; citadel 520/680.
- Starting profile: 320 gold, 2 health potions, 1 mana potion, all starter weapons owned.
- Recommended screen flow: title overlay on 3D hero lineup; class select with 3D selected hero + cards; lobby with player, Maelis, Brasa, map board; adventure HUD with lobby button top-right.
- Need ensure `src/main.js` doesn't exceed tool output limits; split into multiple `write`/`edit` calls or create modules if needed.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a 3D Android-friendly browser action RPG inspired by *Champions of Norrath*, with 5 playable classes, 4 maps, real-time combat, a lobby with a vendor and guide dog, a shop, and a lobby-return button.

## Requirements
- The user request is in Portuguese: "Crie um jogo, como Champions of Norrath de ps2 em 3d, para Android, Com 5 personagens diferentes jogáveis, rpg. Diferentes classes, e poderes, habilidades diferentes, e 4 mapas diferentes, crie também um Botão de ir para a lobby, a lobby terá Uma vendedora com um cachorro guia, ela vende Equipamentos e Armas, sistema de combate. Faça um dos 5 personagens ter um chicote como equipamento."
- 3D action RPG playable on Android mobile browsers.
- 5 distinct playable characters/classes with different powers and abilities.
- 4 different maps.
- Visible "go to lobby" button.
- Lobby containing a female vendor with a guide dog; she sells equipment and weapons.
- Full combat system.
- One of the five characters must use a whip as their weapon.
- Portuguese UI/text expected.

## Decisions
- Vite + Three.js with procedural low-poly 3D assets; no external model downloads.
- Single-page flow: title → character select → lobby → map select → adventure → victory/defeat → lobby.
- Title: **Lendas de Aethermoor**.
- Classes: Kaelen/O Guardião, Lyra/A Feiticeira, Vex/A Lâmina Sombria, Sylva/A Domadora, Seraphine/A Dançarina do Açoite (whip).
- Maps: Cripta de Brasa, Ruínas de Verdan, Vale Glacial, Cidadela do Eclipse.
- Vendor Maelis and guide dog Brasa.
- Procedural portraits/vendor portrait/map thumbnails generated at boot via temporary WebGL renderer.
- Profile/gold/equipment/completed maps saved to `localStorage` (`aethermoor-save-v1`).
- WebAudio procedural music/SFX, touch joystick, combat buttons, keyboard support, minimap, damage numbers, enemy bars, boss bar, buffs, potions, shop.

## Work State
### Completed
- All core modules now exist and pass `node --check`.
- `src/main.js` implemented with boot, title/select/lobby/adventure flow, camera follow, lobby interaction raycast, shop/maps/pause/help/result wiring, sound toggle, save/load, resize, and render loop.
- `src/fx.js` implemented with self-cleaning ring/slash/impact/shockwave/burst effects.
- `src/combat.js` implemented with player movement/attack/dodge/potions, all enemy AI, projectiles, pickups, waves, boss, victory/defeat, loot/XP, minimap/HUD updates.
- `src/abilities.js` implemented for all ability kinds: cone, buff, spin, nova, meteor, dash, fan, pierce, summon, rain, vortex, projectile.
- `src/art.js` implemented for class portraits, Maelis+Brasa portrait, and 4 map thumbnails.
- `src/styles.css` imported from `src/main.js`; added `.dmg-number.gold`.
- `npm install` completed; `npm run build` succeeds.
- Vite dev server running on port 3002; Playwright smoke-tested title, select, lobby, shop, maps, adventure, combat, wave clears, boss spawn, victory, and lobby return.
- Verified save data after victory: gold 309, `completed:["crypt"]`, whipdancer level 3, 438 XP.
- Fixed lobby crash by adding a `PerspectiveCamera` to `lobbyWorld`.
- Adjusted showcase hero scale to `0.78`.
- Changed shadow map type to `THREE.PCFShadowMap` in `main.js` and `art.js`.

### Active
- Visual/functional QA across mobile portrait/landscape and remaining maps/classes.
- Need verify lobby vendor/dog proximity prompt and canvas raycast interaction; current walk test did not reach interaction range (`interact-prompt` still hidden).

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Test mobile viewport (e.g. 390×844 portrait and 844×390 landscape) for title/select/lobby/adventure; fix overflow or control overlap.
2. Test all four maps and at least one non-whip class ability set (mage/huntress/assassin) for runtime errors.
3. Test shop equip flow, pause/help, defeat result, HUD Lobby button, and retry.
4. Verify canvas tap on Maelis/Brasa/map board and proximity prompt.
5. Run final `npm run build` and update `README.md` with controls/instructions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: boot, state transitions, lobby camera/interactions, UI wiring, render loop.
- `src/combat.js`: adventure loop, enemy AI, waves, boss, loot, victory/defeat.
- `src/abilities.js`: all class power implementations.
- `src/art.js`: procedural portraits and map thumbnails.
- `src/fx.js`: transient visual effects.
- `src/worlds.js`: title/showcase/lobby/adventure worlds.
- `src/models.js`: procedural heroes/enemies/vendor/dog/whip/orbs.
- `src/data.js`: classes, abilities, enemies, maps, shop items.
- `src/ui.js`: screens and HUD rendering.
- `src/profile.js`: save/load, stats, XP, purchase/equip.
- `src/input.js`: keyboard, joystick, combat buttons.
- `src/audio.js`: procedural music/SFX.
- `src/styles.css`: all layout and responsive styling.
- `index.html`: DOM structure and element IDs.
- `screenshots/`: captured Playwright QA images.

## Important Context
- Dev server: `http://localhost:3002`; PID in `/tmp/aethermoor-vite.pid`, log at `/tmp/aethermoor-vite.log`.
- Playwright CLI required installing Chromium; browser now works.
- `buildLobbyWorld()` does not return a camera; `main.js` creates `lobbyWorld.camera`.
- `input.attackHeld` auto-attacks; `Adventure` receives `input` and uses `input.getMove()`.
- Ranged enemies stop at ~7.5 units, so melee/whip players must chase them; stationary auto-attack cannot reach.
- Current test save has crypt completed, whipdancer level 3, gold 309, health potions 0.
- Changes remain uncommitted.
